evidence.citation: “Blind-run all three cases again, each in a fresh, context-free agent”; “Sweep the live checkout after every run”; “Repeat important or borderline cases 2–3 times to establish pass rates”; and, after a further revision, “re-evaluate all three cases again to catch regressions.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The required reruns validate the revision, fresh agents and checkout sweeps protect isolation and integrity, repeated borderline cases establish reproducibility, and full re-evaluation after another defect-specific revision checks for regressions. Under the supplied bar, none is materially unnecessary.
